p.THE-PROJECT-HAS-A-GENRE-FOR-STUDYING-EXT: This project has a genre for studying external systems — a competitor, a predecessor, an adjacent tool.

p.A-RESEARCH-DOCUMENT-IS-SELF-CONTAINED-AN: A **comparative research document** is a self-contained, evergreen study: readable months after publication without the original sources, structured as a two-way gap analysis, closing with numbered roadmap deltas.

p.reach-for-the-skeleton-and-hold-the-laws: When the user asks to study, evaluate, or compare against an external system — "what does X actually do?", "should we copy X's feature?", "audit that space before we build" — start from the skeleton in @spec://org.vibevm.world/comparative-research/flows/comparative-research/research-template#root and hold the laws:

facts.LAW-QUOTE-FIRST-CRITIQUE-SECOND: **Quote first, critique second.** The subject speaks in its own words — fenced verbatim quotes with access dates — before any judgement is written.
facts.LAW-TWO-WAY-GAPS: **Two-way gaps.** One section for where we trail, one for where we lead, argued with equal rigor.
facts.LAW-DELTAS-NOT-DECREES: **Deltas, not decrees.** Actionable findings become numbered proposals, each with a priority and a target home in the spec tree. The study never ratifies its own proposals; acceptance happens downstream, per @spec://org.vibevm.world/comparative-research/flows/comparative-research/from-research-to-roadmap#root.
facts.LAW-THE-RE-FETCH-LIST: **Re-fetch list.** Every source URL with access date, plus the subject's version at capture, so the study can be refreshed instead of rewritten.

facts.NEVER-PARAPHRASE-WHERE-A-QUOTE-CAN-STAND: Never paraphrase where a dated verbatim quote can stand — the quote survives link rot; the paraphrase decays into rumor.
facts.NEVER-WRITE-A-ONE-DIRECTIONAL-GAP-ANALYS: Never write a one-directional gap analysis — trail-only is marketing for the subject, lead-only is marketing for us.
facts.NEVER-RATIFY-A-DELTA-INSIDE-THE-RESEARCH: Never ratify a delta inside the research doc — it proposes; acceptance is recorded downstream.
facts.NEVER-LET-A-STUDY-SILENTLY-GO-STALE: Never let a study silently outlive its subject's next major release — stale-flag it and refresh via the re-fetch list.
